description: Synthetic, committed, network-free. Every case is answerable from the fixtures under sources/ and the transcripts under transcripts/. Cases select their own profile: the failing fixtures live in profiles of their own so a source that always fails cannot make every case report degraded coverage. Budgets and thresholds here are absolute first-run placeholders, to be replaced by regression bounds once measured distributions exist.

baseline.note: Measured over 41 cases on darwin/arm64, all nine gates passing. nDCG@10 0.7665, Recall@5 0.9028, Recall@20 1.0, MRR@10 0.6553, Success@5 1.0; abstention, coverage, provenance, source-outcome and locator accuracy all 1.0. Cold and warm runs produced identical metrics - the index is rebuilt at handshake either way, so there is no warm path to diverge from - and p95 was 81ms against a 400ms budget, roughly 5x headroom rather than a number tuned to just pass. exact_identifier_success_at_1 is 0.4 and is recorded as a floor, not a target: two of five identifier cases put a document's title chunk above the section judged authoritative, which is the first thing worth improving. Re-recorded 2026-07-27 for td-92c7b7, which stopped a question admitting a chunk that carries one of its terms and nothing else. Every required lineage in this pack is still returned and every gate still passes; pooled nDCG@10 rose 0.7668 to 0.7762 and MRR@10 0.6563 to 0.7089, and Recall@5 and Recall@20 are unchanged at 0.9444 and 1.0. What moved down is named rather than averaged away: nDCG in the alias, lineage and near-miss tag groups, and Recall@5 in the handbook and notes source families, because three cases lose a chunk judged 2 that was reached by a single word — runbooks/backup-restore.md#L3-L7 was retrieved for "what do we do after we lose data" on the word "we", and glossary.md#L3-L7 for a question about clustering on the word "record". Those are the retrievals this pack was measuring as successes and the ticket was written to stop; the result sets they came from went from ten and fifteen results to one and four. A pack that is a floor under retrieval quality has to record that trade rather than absorb it, which is what this paragraph is. Re-recorded 2026-07-28 for td-c5ef32, which lets a query term reach the other grammatical number of itself, but only where the source holds no spelling of that term at all. Every gate still passes and nothing measured moved down: pooled nDCG@10 rose 0.7856 to 0.7964 and every other pooled metric is unchanged, including MRR@10 at 0.7096 — the rule reorders nothing that was already found, because a term the corpus spells the caller's way is never expanded. The gain is one case reaching a chunk it had been missing on a plural. firstuse does not move at all, which is the point of the gate: its "what is the sidecar project for" holds "project" literally, and an ungated expansion put a document that only says "projects" above the project record and admitted a fifth result past the relevance floor.
